risks: Observability must not add raw user, tenant, path, query, body, token or secret values as metric/log labels.
Alert thresholds must remain configuration-driven and must not weaken authentication, RBAC, tenant isolation or rate limiting.
Later N8.12 stages may expand validation, but PRE must not reimplement correct existing code merely because historical evidence exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh current-state map exists and is consistent with current Desarrollo source/tests.
Current observability implementation remains bounded-cardinality and secret-safe.
Correlation and request-level metrics/alert signals remain present.
Current backend source and tests are exact-tree equivalent to a freshly tested functional head, or new causal tests run on exact current head.
No P0/P1 remains before PRE LISTO.

rollback.rule: If revalidation finds a material P0/P1, reopen only the causal N8.12 scope and correct it before promotion; do not weaken security or delete valid observability.

historicalTargetedObservabilityRun.use: supporting evidence only; freshness supplied by exact backend source/tests equivalence to the 2026-09-17 tested functional head
